description: Witness Receipts over a CLL anchor and the anchor_witnessed report (§6.2.2). Generated by python/scripts/generate_anchor_witness_v1_vectors.py. Times are NumericDates; keys are hex DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo test keys derived from public labels; the anchor digests are label digests.

cases.name: pass-eddsa-time
cases.description: one EdDSA Receipt with a protected iat (§6.2.2 steps 1 to 5)

cases.name: pass-eddsa-no-time
cases.description: no CWT_Claims: PASS with no registration time (step 5)

cases.name: pass-es256-time
cases.description: an ES256 Receipt under a P-256 key (step 3)

cases.name: pass-single-leaf
cases.description: a tree of one leaf: an empty inclusion path (RFC 9162 §2.1.3)

cases.name: pass-rotated-key
cases.description: the first key of witness-a's row does not verify, the second does (step 3)

cases.name: pass-second-proof
cases.description: the first inclusion proof rebuilds another root, the second this anchor's

cases.name: earliest-time-and-its-witness
cases.description: two passing Receipts: the earlier time, with the witness that signed it

cases.name: timed-before-untimed
cases.description: an untimed Receipt first: the anchor's time and witness come from the timed one

cases.name: equal-times-first-received
cases.description: two Receipts with one time: the first received names the witness

cases.name: untimed-first-received
cases.description: no passing Receipt has a time: the first passing one names the witness

cases.name: pass-beside-fail
